text:
Here lived Chenca, that jewel

        expensive for her fittings; this room

        was the tomb of the sixth commandment

        and the galley where Love was a good buoy.


        By God, this room that supports her

        throws sparks of lust into the wind!

        Her boldness invented this trap

        to play man with stage machinery.


        From that window, the insolence

        of her hair affronted the east,

        and in this one her glance was a sword thrust.


        But, O cruel penance for both!

        today the house shelters a suitor,

        and the famous Chenca is married.

translation.title: To the House of a Courtesan Where a Suitor Came to Live
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the house as bawdy stage, commandment-tomb, and comic punishment.
